lead.zh: 这篇访谈具体说明 Southeastern 怎样交叉核算企业价值。它把资产、现金流与可比交易分开，不把一个估值倍数当作完整答案。
lead.en: This interview explains Southeastern’s cross-checks using assets, cash flows and comparable transactions rather than a single valuation multiple.

paragraphs.zh: 第一种方法从资产负债表出发，按当前价值调整资产与负债，再估计股东拥有的净值。
paragraphs.en: The first method adjusts assets and liabilities to current values to estimate the value belonging to shareholders.

heading.zh: 核算真正可取出的现金
heading.en: Estimate cash an owner can withdraw

paragraphs.zh: 现金流方法扣除维持竞争力所需的资本投入与营运资本。无法预测的企业，不应被强行塞进稳定现金流模型。
paragraphs.en: The cash-flow method deducts maintenance investment and working capital. Unpredictable businesses should not be forced into stable cash-flow models.

heading.zh: 比较交易只作交叉核对

paragraphs.zh: 第三种方法参考实际收购交易。不同方法互相检验；市场价格与估值的比率描述折价，但估值本身也需要复核。
paragraphs.en: The third method uses acquisition transactions. Methods cross-check one another; a price-to-value discount still depends on a sound appraisal.

questions.zh: 阅读问题：你估算的现金流，是否扣除了维持现有经营必须花掉的那部分钱？
questions.en: Reading question: Does your cash-flow estimate deduct spending necessary to maintain the existing business?
